name: Extra content
_howto: Add questions to the items[] list below, commit this file to GitHub, and the game will load them automatically the next time it is opened. Nothing else has to change.

_fields.r: chamber: verb | tense | vocab | order | habit
_fields.t: format: mcq | gap | forms | order | scramble | vowels | listen
_fields.q: the question. For a gap use ___ where the word is missing
_fields.o: multiple choice options, CORRECT ONE FIRST (they are shuffled on screen)
_fields.a: accepted answers for typed formats, e.g. ["doesn't work", "does not work"]
_fields.lv: class levels that see it: [1,6] = 1º ESO to 2º Bach
_fields.tip: the feedback shown after the answer
_fields.hint: for gap questions, the base verb shown in brackets

_examples.q: Which word means a person who travels to work every day?
_examples.tip: A commuter travels between home and work.
Since + a point in time → present perfect.
